description: One transaction read and explained in plain words: who moved what to whom, through which programs, the swap or bridge transfer it made, its parties with their labels, and (Solana) the wallets it shows are controlled by the same owner. A Solana signature, an EVM hash, or a dYdX, Noble, Bitcoin or Tron hash. Free with an Iris account (limited per minute, and per day without a paid plan).

chain.description: Optional: the chain. Read from the hash otherwise (an EVM hash is looked for on every EVM chain).

hash.description: The transaction: a Solana signature (base58), an EVM hash (0x...), or a dYdX, Noble, Bitcoin or Tron hash.

name: explain_transaction
title: Explain one transaction
